Keisen has no release yet, so there is nothing to show working.

Every example on this page will be a table this site compiles itself, from the source printed beside it, so the page cannot drift from what the library does.
Pasted output of an idealised run is not worth reading.

## Planned examples

The examples arrive with the features they need:

- A grouped table with subtotals, footnote marks, and a source note.
- A long table that breaks across pages, reprinting both the column labels and the current group label.
- A table with in-cell nanoplots sharing one domain down the column.
- A table built from a specification produced outside Typst, proving the generator path.

Progress is tracked in the [issue tracker](https://github.com/{{< var repository.slug >}}/issues).
